name: Trusting In The Lord
overview: Scripture reveals that trusting in the Lord is foundational for spiritual strength and security, as the psalmist declares God to be both strength and shield, inspiring heartfelt praise (Psalms 28:7). Trust involves dwelling in God’s presence and finding refuge under His protection (Psalms 91:1), which leads to a steadfast heart unshaken by fear or evil news (Psalms 112:7). Proverbs emphasizes wholehearted trust in the Lord rather than relying on human understanding, promising divine guidance and safety for those who acknowledge Him in all their ways (Proverbs 3:5-6; 29:25).
